question: Does the unchanged positive registered planar-extent support rule preserve exact partial-roster correspondence on a newly materialized 3RScan family?

predecessor.observed_effect: On six fresh same-class doorframes, positive registered planar extent support improved rank-only F1 0.985507 to 1.0, removed four false matches without losing a true match, and made all 33 unmatched sets exact.

source.materialization: Only semseg.v2.json and labels.instances.annotated.v2.ply for the first metadata-ranked eligible unconsumed family were materialized through the previously authorized official 3RScan downloader; no RGB, depth, or sequence archive was downloaded.

frozen_cohort.selection_order: Exclude every reference scan family and physical target in the eleven consumed cohorts. From locally available geometry, group candidate rows by scan family and normalized semantic class in the predecessor first-occurrence order. Choose the first family/class with four distinct surfaces on both scans and take its first four rows before computing surface scores or extent overlaps.
frozen_cohort.scenario_contract: Use one closed-four scenario, one query-extra scenario, one reference-extra scenario, and all twelve ordered balanced missing-plus-extra swaps across the four same-class targets.
forbidden: changing the predecessor pair score, reciprocal rule, portal frame, convex hull, or strictly-positive-overlap predicate
using surface scores or extent overlaps to choose the family, targets, or swaps
dropping any balanced swap after observing outcomes
downloading RGB, depth, or sequence data for selection

frozen_model.pair_score: Unchanged negative symmetric median nearest-surface distance after the official rigid transform.
frozen_model.absolute_support: Unchanged strictly positive intersection area between registered portal-plane convex hulls, with no IoU magnitude threshold.
frozen_model.zero_assignment: Unchanged strict reciprocal surface edge retained only under positive absolute support.
frozen_model.baselines: Complete Hungarian assignment and strict reciprocal rank-only surface matching.

decision_gate.support_true_matches: All frozen truth correspondences across all scenarios.
decision_gate.zero_assignment: Exact unmatched reference and query sets in every frozen scenario.
decision_gate.incremental_opportunity: Reported but not required: rank-only may or may not emit a false positive on this independent family.
decision_gate.single_replay: One replay on the frozen scan-family-disjoint cohort; do not tune or rerun after outcome.

claim_boundary: A pass is same-provider but scan-family-disjoint real-geometry Development confirmation that the unchanged positive registered planar-extent support rule preserves exact partial-roster correspondence for four truth-proposed same-class indoor doors. Provider labels, complete surfaces, and the official rigid transform remain privileged. It is not raw-phone perception, door detection, a portal aperture, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, provider-independent confirmation, user benefit, or mobility safety.
